The moment of choice

They’re already here.

They’ve booked the room.

They’ve arrived in the area.

Now they’re deciding where to have dinner, what to do tomorrow, where to take the family or how to make the most of a few days away.

That is the moment Strictons is designed around. Not months before the trip. Not while they’re scrolling at home.

While they’re here.

Part of the experience

Be part of the stay.

A Strictons guide is not designed as a directory of advertisers. It is designed around the experience the hotel wants its guests to have.

A restaurant worth crossing town for.A vineyard.A family attraction.A gallery.A charter.A local shop they’ll remember.

If your business belongs in that experience, we can introduce it to the hotel.

Useful first. Commercial second.

Selected by the hotel

Recommended by the place they’re staying.

Every business featured in a guide is reviewed and approved by the hotel first. The hotel decides what feels right for its property, its destination and its guests.

You are not simply appearing beside a hotel. You are becoming part of the experience it chooses to put into its guests’ hands.

Nothing appears without hotel approval.

When they are deciding

Right guest.
Right place.
Right moment.

A guest looking through their hotel guide is in a very different moment from someone scrolling past an advertisement. They are nearby, looking for somewhere to go and reading something designed specifically for their stay.

A useful signal

Know when they take the next step.

Every featured business has its own QR code inside the physical guide. When a guest scans to learn more, we track it.

You receive a simple monthly report showing how often hotel guests chose to take that next step with your business.

A scan shows intent. It does not prove a booking.

We handle the presentation

We’ll make it fit.

You do not need to design an advertisement. We ask for your imagery, information and brand assets, then create your presence so it feels consistent with the hotel and the rest of the experience.

We also build and maintain your page in the live version. If your booking link, offer or information changes, let us know and we will update it.

You provide the business. We take care of the presentation.

Limited by design

Not every business belongs in every guide.

Every property attracts a different kind of guest. Every destination has different places worth discovering.

Placements are selected guide by guide and offered in limited numbers. The hotel has final approval over every business included.

We cannot guarantee a place simply because a business wants to participate.

It has to make sense for the guest.
